channel.description: Recent content in French Edition on Aljareeda

item.title: Morocco Opens 12 New Offshore Oil Blocks to Foreign Drillers
item.description: Morocco’s Bulletin Officiel n°7510: 12 new offshore oil blocks for foreign drillers, butane gas margin changes, a telecom fiber-sharing deal, plus aquaculture licenses and medical diploma recognitions.

item.title: Morocco Licenses 7 Seed and Plant Sellers, Then Makes Them Report Sales
item.description: Seven seed and plant companies get five-year licences with mandatory sales reporting to the food safety office, and the Marchica 1 marina gets its operating rules. Here is what Morocco’s Official Gazette No. 7540 means for Moroccans abroad and outside observers.

item.title: EU's Carbon Border Tax Kicks In — Morocco's Fertilizer Exports First in the Crosshairs
item.description: The EU’s carbon border tax is now live and Morocco’s fertilizer exports are exposed first; plus a €100M French water loan, 17,000 km² leased for offshore oil exploration, and a state bank still unable to close its books after 13 years.

item.title: Morocco Borrows $460M From World Bank for Jobs and Green Growth While Its Own Watchdog Says Only 0.5% of Companies Ever Use Job-Training Funds
item.description: A digest of Morocco’s Official Gazette, issue №7526: a $460M World Bank loan for jobs and green growth, a damning report on Morocco’s broken job-training system, a new financial-futures player, and an offshore gas deal.

item.title: Morocco Suspends Bread Wheat Import Duty as Global Grain Costs Bite
item.description: Morocco toggles its bread wheat import duty to manage prices, secures water-stress financing from the Islamic Development Bank, and recognizes foreign medical and architecture diplomas for Moroccans trained abroad.
